svg.text: Original StegaStamp (Tancik et al., CVPR 2020) · Fixed 400×400 · 100 bits · U-Net Encoder + CNN Decoder + STN + WGAN Discriminator
All activations: ReLU unless noted · Init: Kaiming He normal
Input: image (3×400×400) + message (100 bits) → Output: encoded image (3×400×400)
⚠ conv10: Conv2d(32→32,3×3) computed but NOT used
Input: encoded image (3×400×400) → Output: decoded bits (100 logits)
Output: raw logits · sigmoid applied for training loss
1. Message enters as spatial map at encoder input — concatenated with image as 6-channel input
2. Encoder outputs a residual that is ADDED to the original image (no clamping for gradient flow)
3. conv10 is defined and computed but its output is discarded — residual takes conv9 output directly
4. STN initialized to identity transform (weight=0, bias=[1,0,0,0,1,0]) — learns geometric correction
5. Decoder outputs raw logits — sigmoid applied only during loss computation (BCEWithLogitsLoss)
6. No BatchNorm anywhere — matches original TensorFlow StegaStamp implementation
7. All weights initialized with Kaiming normal (He) — mode="fan_in", nonlinearity="relu"
• Message Loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss(decoder_logits, target_bits) · scale=7.0, ramp_steps=1
• L2 Loss: MSE(encoded_image, original_image) · scale=1.0, ramp_steps=20000
• LPIPS Loss: Perceptual similarity · scale=1.5, ramp_steps=20000
